# dsh-git-workbench
**A JetBrains-style Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness.** Local Changes tree, hunk- and line-level s
taging, side-by-side diff, commit window, commit graph, annotate, interactive rebase, shelve, three-
way conflict resolution — all next to the conversation, no terminal switching.
> The goal is not "being able to commit", but seeing **which line changed, which hunk gets staged, a
nd which branch the commit lands on** as clearly as in IDEA.
中文 · Features · HTTP API · Architecture · Design notes · Development
## What it is
DSH's right sidebar is a draggable tab area, which maps to IDE tool windows; the diff opens in the m
ain area like an editor tab and is a **singleton** — opening another file replaces the content inste
ad of stacking tabs.
| JetBrains | Here | Contents |
| Commit tool window | **Commit** tab | changes tree + changelists + conflicts + message + `AI` / `R

ecent` / `Checks` / `Amend` |
| Log tool window | **History** tab | commit graph + commit details +

file list, read-only |
| Editor diff tab | **Diff** view (main area) | side-by-side / unified, hunk
& line staging, annotate, conflict view |
Commit and history keep their own selection, scroll, filters and draft; the diff decides what it sho
ws and whether it is writable from its `source` (`working` = writable, `commit` / `turn` = read-only
and whether it is writable from its `source` (`working` = writable, `commit` / `turn` = read-only).
It also plugs into DSH surfaces you already use: the branch chip in the session header, the branch p
icker in the new-session hero, the `Git` buttons on turn cards and the Files tab, and the change bar
above the composer. The repository follows the session cwd — switching sessions switches repositori
ove the composer. The repository follows the session cwd — switching sessions switches repositories.

Everything is editable in **Settings → Plugins → Git workbench**, or in the profile's `cordis.patch.

Unwritten keys take the defaults above. `readOnly: true` turns the workbench into a read-only review
panel: staging, committing, branches, the network and conflict resolution are all disabled, and the
HTTP write endpoints return 403 (except `/config`).
## Highlights
- **Staging** — whole file, hunk (cropped patch → `git apply --cached`), or individual lines; unstag

ing is equally precise. Commits always use the index.
- **Reading diffs** — side-by-side / unified,
dual line numbers, word-level highlights, ignore-whitespace (read-only), context folding, `‹ n/m ›`

file navigation and `F7` hunk navigation.
- **Committing** — `Ctrl+Enter`, AI draft, `↑` to recall p
revious messages, amend, changelists, and before-commit checks taken from the repo's own `package.js

on` scripts.
- **History** — DAG graph, sortable and resizable columns, group by branch/author/date,
structured filters (`author:` `message:` `hash:` `tag:` `branch:` `date:`), multi-select for batch

cherry-pick / revert.
- **Rewriting history** — interactive rebase (pick/squash/fixup/drop), reword,

undo commit, cherry-pick, revert, soft/hard reset — all behind explicit confirmations.
- **Branches
& remotes** — switch/create/rename, `↑N ↓N` ahead-behind badges, set/unset upstream, compare, rebas

e onto, fetch/pull/push (Pick a remote on first push), manage remotes.
- **Conflicts & sequencer** —
separate unmerged group, three-way view with per-block choices or a hand-written merged result, sta

tus bar with continue/abort while a merge, cherry-pick or rebase is paused.
- **Stash** — name + sel
ect files (partial stash uses a temporary index so unrelated staged content is untouched), read-only

preview, apply/pop/drop.
- **Git console** — every real argv, exit code, duration and output per re

pository; failures expand automatically.
- **Empty directory** — one-click `git init` without touchi

ng existing files.
- **Bilingual** — follows DSH's language preference (falling back to the browser
language) and switches live; git's English refusals are localized rather than dumped into the UI.
The full 50+ item comparison against JetBrains is in docs/features.md.
## Keyboard shortcuts
| Action | Shortcut / gesture |

| Refresh | `F5` |
| Commit | `Ctrl/Cmd + Enter` |
| Focus the message box | `Ctrl/Cmd + K` |
| Draf

t the message with the model | `Ctrl/Cmd + G` |
| Previous / next file | `Alt + ↑` / `Alt + ↓`, or t

he `‹ n/m ›` in the diff header |
[该节后续省略]
## Security
Every git call is `spawn('git', argv)` with **no shell**; writes are serialized; paths are validated
against `..` and option injection; cross-origin requests are rejected; `readOnly: true` blocks all
writes; no credentials are ever collected and network operations never prompt (120 s timeout, `GIT_T
ERMINAL_PROMPT=0`). Details: docs/architecture.md.
